description: Search a global company database and get matching companies with industry, size, location and website. Three ways to ask: a company's website ('warmly.ai') returns that one company, the most exact way to identify one; a company's name ('Warmly') returns the companies of that name; a description in plain English ('Series B fintech companies in London with 50-200 employees') returns the companies that fit it. Searching companies uses no credits. It also works before a PeopleSearch.im account is connected: without one it returns up to 3 companies per search, up to 10 searches a day.

query.description: A company's website, a company's name, or the companies you want described in plain English.
